Usage: expressvpnctl [options] command [parameters...]
Command-line interface to the ExpressVPN client.  Some commands, such as connect, require that the graphical client is also running.

Options:
  --timeout, -t <seconds>  Sets timeout for one-shot commands.
  --debug, -d              Prints debug logs to stderr.
  --help, -h               Displays this help.
  -v, --version            Displays version information.

Arguments:
  command                  Command to execute
  parameters               Parameters for the command

Commands:
  background
    usage: background <enable|disable>
    Allow the Network Lock (kill switch) and/or VPN connection to remain active in the background when the GUI client is not running.
    When enabled, the ExpressVPN daemon will stay active even if the GUI client is closed or has not been started.
    This allows `expressvpnctl connect` to be used even if the GUI client is not running.
    Disabling background activation will disconnect the VPN and deactivate Split Tunnel if the GUI client is not running.
    This needs to be enabled for autoconnect on system startup to work.
    
  connect
    usage: connect [region]
    Connects to the VPN, or reconnects to apply new settings.
    To use this command, the ExpressVPN GUI client must be running, or background mode must be enabled with `expressvpnctl background enable`
    (By default, the ExpressVPN daemon is inactive when the GUI client is not running.)
    You may optionally pass a region as a parameter. That region will then be set before connecting.
    
  dedicatedip
    Usage: dedicatedip <status|unlock|ip>
    Check status, unlock your Dedicated Ip Subscription or get the actual ip address (if unlocked)
    
  disconnect
    Disconnects from the VPN.
    
  dumpdiagnostics
    usage: dumpdiagnostics
    Writes a diagnostics file and prints its path.
    Debug logging must be enabled.
    
  get
    usage: get <type>
    Get information from the ExpressVPN daemon.
    Available types:
      - allowlan - Whether to allow LAN traffic
      - autoconnect - Whether to connect on system startup. Requires background permissions to connect. Use this option together with killswitch to ensure the system will be protected from startup.
      - blockAds - Whether advanced protection is blocking Ads
      - blockAdult - Whether advanced protection is blocking Adult sites
      - blockAll - Whether advanced protection is fully enabled
      - blockMalicious - Whether advanced protection is blocking Malicious sites
      - blockTrackers - Whether advanced protection is blocking Trackers
      - connectionstate - VPN connection state
        values: Disconnected, Connecting, Connected, Interrupted, Reconnecting, DisconnectingToReconnect, Disconnecting
      - debuglogging - State of debug logging setting
      - dnsconfigured - Whether DNS configuration is complete
      - networklock - Network Lock status
      - protocol - VPN connection protocol
        values: auto, lightwayudp, lightwaytcp, openvpnudp, openvpntcp, wireguard
      - pubip - Your public IP address as provided by your ISP
      - region - Currently selected region (or "smart")
      - regions - List all available regions
      - smart - The current smart region
      - split-app - Split Tunnel rules
      - splittunnel - Split Tunnel status
      - vpnip - IP address assigned by the VPN server (Unknown when disconnected)
    
  install-chrome-extension
    Open the browser to download and install the Chrome browser extension
    
  install-firefox-extension
    Open the browser to download and install the Firefox browser extension
    
  login
    usage: login <login_file>
    Log in to your ExpressVPN account.
    Put your activation code or your username and password on separate lines in a text file,
    and specify that file on the command line:
        (your activation code)
    or
        (youremail)
        (yourpassword)
    
  logout
    Log out your ExpressVPN account on this computer.
    
  mcp
    usage: mcp [enable|disable]
    Manage the MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.
    With no arguments, shows the current MCP server status.
      enable  - Start the MCP server
      disable - Stop the MCP server
    
  monitor
    usage: monitor <type>
    Monitors the  ExpressVPN  daemon for changes in a specific setting or state value.
    When a connection is established, the current value is printed.
    When a change is received, the new value is printed.
    Available types:
      - allowlan - Whether to allow LAN traffic
      - autoconnect - Whether to connect on system startup. Requires background permissions to connect. Use this option together with killswitch to ensure the system will be protected from startup.
      - blockAds - Whether advanced protection is blocking Ads
      - blockAdult - Whether advanced protection is blocking Adult sites
      - blockAll - Whether advanced protection is fully enabled
      - blockMalicious - Whether advanced protection is blocking Malicious sites
      - blockTrackers - Whether advanced protection is blocking Trackers
      - connectionstate - VPN connection state
        values: Disconnected, Connecting, Connected, Interrupted, Reconnecting, DisconnectingToReconnect, Disconnecting
      - debuglogging - State of debug logging setting
      - dnsconfigured - Whether DNS configuration is complete
      - networklock - Network Lock status
      - protocol - VPN connection protocol
        values: auto, lightwayudp, lightwaytcp, openvpnudp, openvpntcp, wireguard
      - pubip - Your public IP address as provided by your ISP
      - region - Currently selected region (or "smart")
      - smart - The current smart region
      - split-app - Split Tunnel rules
      - splittunnel - Split Tunnel status
      - vpnip - IP address assigned by the VPN server (Unknown when disconnected)
    
  resetsettings
    Resets daemon settings to the defaults (advanced protection/ports/protocols/etc.)
    Client settings won't be affected by this command.
    
  set
    usage: set <type> <value>
    Change settings in the  ExpressVPN  daemon.
    Available types:
      - allowlan - Whether to allow LAN traffic
      - autoconnect - Whether to connect on system startup
      - blockAds - Whether to block ads
      - blockAdult - Whether to block adult content
      - blockAll - Whether to enable all advanced blockers. This will change all block settings at once.
      - blockMalicious - Whether to block malicious content
      - blockTrackers - Whether to block trackers
      - debuglogging - Enable or disable debug logging
      - networklock - Whether to enable Network Lock
      - protocol - Select a VPN protocol
      - region - Select a region (or "smart")
      - split-app - Edit Split Tunnel app rules. Choose to bypass, force through vpn or remove the rule. e.g.:
      		set split-app bypass:/usr/lib/firefox/firefox
      		set split-app vpn:/usr/lib/firefox/firefox
      		set split-app remove:/usr/lib/firefox/firefox
      - splittunnel - Whether to enable Split Tunnel
    
  speedtest
    usage: speedtest [json] [automatic|manual] [location-id]
    Run a speedtest on your current connection
    Measures ping latency, jitter, packet loss, and HTTP download/upload bandwidth
    Use 'json' as first argument for JSON output format
    
  status
    Show status summary
    
  submitdiagnostics
    usage: submitdiagnostics
    Submits the most recent existing diagnostics file to CSI and prints the ticket code.
    Use 'dumpdiagnostics' first to create a diagnostics file.
    
Examples:
  To activate your ExpressVPN account:
    expressvpnctl login myAccountTokenFile
  
  To connect to smart location:
    expressvpnctl connect smart
  
  To set the default location:
    expressvpnctl set region "germany-frankfurt-1"
  
  To connect to the default location:
    expressvpnctl connect
  
  To connect to a specific location:
    expressvpnctl connect "germany-frankfurt-1"
  
  To check current connection status:
    expressvpnctl status
  
  To disable Network Lock:
    expressvpnctl set networklock false
  
  To enable advanced protection features:
    - 'expressvpnctl set blockAll true' to block ads, trackers, malicious and adult sites
    - 'expressvpnctl set blockAds true' to block ads
    - 'expressvpnctl set blockTrackers true' to block trackers
    - 'expressvpnctl set blockMalicious true' to block malicious sites
    - 'expressvpnctl set blockAdult true' to block adult sites
